links.outcome: Readability of chatbot responses about idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis
links.effect: Overall readability of chatbot responses was low, corresponding to high educational requirements; Gemini was the most readable and understandable.
links.quote: The overall readability of chatbot-generated responses was low, corresponding to high educational requirements.

screen.reason: Evaluates the readability, reliability, and quality of responses from four general commercial LLM chatbots to patient-oriented questions about idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis without testing a deployment safeguard or organizational intervention.
